description: Daily upload limit of a connected YouTube channel (uploads per day; the day resets at midnight Pacific time like Google's quota). The upload queue pauses the channel when it is reached and continues the next day. Default 15. Called by an agent, the change is parked for approval.

channel_id.description: YouTube channel id (UC…) from list_youtube_channels; optional when only one channel is connected

name: set_youtube_channel_limit
